routes.fit_reason: This route provides a dedicated podcast studio with all necessary microphones and recording equipment. It is ideal for beginners wanting an easy recording space.

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Plan your podcast episode outline and talking points about campus food with your friends.

steps.title: Check sizes
steps.detail: Confirm that the podcast studio seats four people so you and your two friends will fit comfortably.

steps.title: Ask staff
steps.detail: Email spaces@usc.edu or call the ITS Learning Environments team at (213) 821-6601 to reserve the podcast studio.

warnings.issue: Background noise can ruin the recording.
warnings.fix: Keep voices steady and close to the headsets during recording.
